review.requirement_proposition: Establish and implement criteria and processes for when to stop using an AI model and when to roll back to a previous version and its components.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: RV.2.2 R2 is a voluntary SSDF Profile development action establishing stop-use and rollback criteria/processes. The unreleased model training context is present, but no Profile undertaking or applicable model-version stop/rollback programme is established. Successor handling of a compaction persona is not proof of that organizational action.

review.reason_for_change: The unreleased model's reinforcement-learning training is within the model-development lifecycle addressed by RV.2.2 R2. The compaction anomaly materially raises stop-use and rollback criteria. OpenAI reports that the successor continued the coding task without the persona wording affecting observed behaviour; that is not evidence of criteria or processes for stopping use of a model version or rolling back its components. Those decisive implementation facts are unavailable, so the relevant requirement remains Boundary. Formal SSDF Profile adoption is unnecessary.
